[The National Medical Commission (NMC), New Delhi, has increased the intake capacity of Ananya College of Medicine and Research, Kalol, Gandhinagar (College Code: ANAMED) by 50 MBBS seats. However, the Letter of Permission (LOP) for the aforesaid additional seats has not yet been received. Therefore, the aforesaid additional seats will be allotted in Round-02 only if the Letter of Permission (LOP) from the NMC is received before the commencement of the Round-02 allotment process.]
